_meta.title: huiying Filter Replacement-Interval Reference
_meta.purpose: Industry-common replacement intervals for the five filter categories. Reference guidance only; always follow the vehicle/engine manufacturer's schedule first.
_meta.disclaimer: Intervals are industry-common REFERENCE values (kilometres / months), not Huiying product specifications and not a substitute for the OEM service schedule. Adjust for local conditions and confirm per application.

intervals.label: Engine Air Filter
intervals.note: Shorten to 5,000–10,000 km in heavy-dust / sand regions

intervals.label: Engine Oil Filter
intervals.note: Replace with every oil change; synthetic oil may extend the oil-change interval

intervals.label: Cabin Air Filter
intervals.note: Replace before the humid / rainy season to avoid musty smell

intervals.label: Fuel Filter
intervals.note: Diesel and commercial applications shorten toward the lower bound

intervals.label: Wiper
intervals.note: Replace on streaking, chatter or reduced clarity

factors.effect: Shortens engine-air, cabin and oil intervals (desert, unpaved, construction)
Cabin filter replaced more often; watch for mould and fogging
Stop-and-go / short trips shorten oil and fuel intervals
Poor or contaminated fuel shortens fuel-filter life
Lower-grade oil loads the oil filter faster
Always the primary authority — this table is a secondary reference

suggestions.author: 小筑 ✍️
suggestions.region: 中国华北 / 西北沙尘地区
suggestions.text: 空气滤清器建议缩短至 5,000–10,000 km 或按需更换；沙尘较大时推荐同时检查空调滤。

suggestions.author: 小筑 ✍️
suggestions.text: 空调滤建议每年雨季前更换，避免霉味与出风減弱；优先选择活性炭层款。

suggestions.author: 小筑 ✍️
suggestions.text: 燃油滤建议按 20,000 km 或压差指示更换，对油水系统的保护价值高于件价本身。
